title: Emails » Compose Emails
text:
## Emails » Compose Emails
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076567
To compose an email from the back end, navigate to Emails - Compose Email:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180354373/original/sJVSdyTJK7BmE07EdMleFx0Qgfnn0Ltumw.png?1781301820 | alt: ]

## Overview of the Fields
Clicking the "Compose Email" button will open a modal window displaying the available fields and options for writing and sending a manual email through the system.

## From Name
By default, the website name will be autofilled, this is an editable field nonetheless.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165740575/original/GEQkN8Wx7WptqOKn6u4ojN1E-AAaNnlb3Q.png?1755014887 | alt: ]

## Template
This dropdown contains a list of custom and default email templates .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165740712/original/nvmv_qC2dmTgphLVxCB0dHfAA4HpI8a89w.png?1755015016 | alt: ]

## From Email
The default website email will be autofilled; the prefix is an editable section, nonetheless.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162307345/original/hoimTk7mzSZfz1dYK_R5VP03tTWW4mpVaw.png?1748993663 | alt: ]

## Include Default Website Signature
This dropdown contains options to select between the default Website Signature and the signature of the Admin sending or composing the email.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162307272/original/ywbspMDN0Be0-dvkNfnoizChzk84mFLK0w.png?1748993576 | alt: ]

## Use Different Reply-To-Address
Select the reply-to address (if different from the 'From' email).
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162776475/original/BVHvXd9cnDQrLFmyHU8zFssDTxhtmDQmPQ.png?1749758897 | alt: ]

## Primary Recipients
Add a list of the recipients of this email. Once added, hit ENTER or TAB on the keyboard to add the email address to the recipients field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180354452/original/2NaWznIseJMTrH4lw350H8cset8lMI41bA.png?1781301907 | alt: ]
It sends one email with all of the email addresses listed as recipients.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165741477/original/OJukOrN1I-KCVTmLbeTqVpdkdewDJqm8ZA.png?1755015563 | alt: ]
It send a separate email to each recipient with each individual email address as the recipient.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165741654/original/plRpPV3Q0U_R32wJDg6D994gV3mMnzMetw.png?1755015762 | alt: ]
The CC/BCC option can also be selected to add additional carbon copy fields.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162776333/original/1Vb3MzAzGrk7Tz5whIQixU31bwEG72w0oQ.png?1749758702 | alt: ]

## Subject
Field to add the subject line for the email.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166100075/original/TzdmgOOGEqKqAzNOGb5PbsMxCFe5qmlneg.png?1755622594 | alt: ]

## Email Content and Preview Email
Add the content for the email or the body of the email to this section. Preview the work by selecting this option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166100198/original/aCGWcogv97Ka3GdL0BgpL3l-Du2zk16iaA.png?1755622713 | alt: ]

## Test
The end product by sending it as a test to an admin of the site with a valid email address:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166100300/original/c_zXZaqH0upIXASLRIiM8b43LQyDrxa-xw.png?1755622771 | alt: ]
